summary: V5.5.2 testing — Backend XP Ledger endpoint passes ALL 5 pytest cases (401/403/404/shape/award+convert). Frontend XPLedgerPanel component EXISTS but the trigger button data-testid='xp-ledger-btn' is NEVER rendered in CampaignDetail.jsx — feature is unusable from the UI. MacroBar testing was blocked by SessionView's loading screen ('OPENING THE TABLE') not clearing within 15s in the live preview environment, preventing observation of dice-panel and macro-bar mounting.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='xp-ledger-btn' is NEVER RENDERED. The component imports XPLedgerPanel, declares const [showLedger, setShowLedger] = useState(false) on line 26 and conditionally renders <XPLedgerPanel> when showLedger && camp.is_gm on line 184, but NO button anywhere calls setShowLedger(true). grep -n 'setShowLedger' returns only the useState declaration and the onClose handler — there is no trigger. As a result, GMs cannot open the campaign-level XP ledger from the UI even though the backend endpoint /api/campaigns/{cid}/xp/ledger works correctly.

Live preview never advances past the 'OPENING THE TABLE / TUNING THE CANDLES · ALMOST READY' loading screen within 15s+ for an existing open BESM session (session id 22e59b59060c4912b72e5e6a37d1a4f0, campaign f7403305c6734ffb8fe689ade67627cb). useMinDelay(!session, 5000) on line 136 holds the spinner for at least 5 s but the screen lingers far longer. dice-panel never mounts, blocking validation of MacroBar render, macro-* testids, char-aware notation, and session-roll-btn integration in this environment.

integration_issues.issue: Backend endpoint works perfectly (5/5 pytest cases pass) but cannot be reached from the UI because the trigger button is missing.

tests_executed.backend_pytest_iter28_v552: 5/5 PASS — TestLedgerAccess (401, 403, 404), TestLedgerShape (200 + all required keys: characters, entries, totals.{awarded,converted,unspent}, weights, bonus_cap, default_baseline), TestLedgerAwardAndConvert (POST /characters/{cid}/xp adds an entry with correct amount/reason/awarded_at/source; POST /characters/{cid}/xp/convert adds a second entry with source=='convert' and converted_to_points set).
tests_executed.frontend_campaign_detail_gm: PARTIAL FAIL — Logged in as GMFran (admin), navigated to /app/campaigns/f7403305c6734ffb8fe689ade67627cb (BESM 4E, 4 chars, 8 sessions). Header testids present: clone-campaign-btn, genesis-btn, director-btn, start-session-btn, delete-campaign-btn — xp-ledger-btn is ABSENT. Code review of CampaignDetail.jsx confirms no element with data-testid='xp-ledger-btn' exists in the file (grep -n 'xp-ledger-btn' /app/frontend/src/components/CampaignDetail.jsx returns 0 lines).
tests_executed.frontend_campaign_detail_player: PASS (vacuously) — Registered new player, navigated to same campaign URL; xp-ledger-btn correctly NOT visible. (But this is also true for GMs, so the GM-gating cannot be distinguished from the missing-button bug.)
tests_executed.frontend_session_macrobar: BLOCKED — 'OPENING THE TABLE' loading screen never cleared within 15s in the preview environment; dice-panel and macro-bar testids never became visible. Could not verify BESM/D&D/Cypher macro buttons or click→notation→roll integration.
tests_executed.frontend_xp_award_popover: BLOCKED — could not reach the XPAwardPanel because (a) it is mounted from the SessionView (which never finished loading) and (b) no xp-* testid was found on the rendered (loading) page.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add the GM-only XP Ledger trigger button to CampaignDetail.jsx header. Looking at the existing pattern for director-btn (line 95) and start-session-btn (line 99), add e.g.: {camp.is_gm && <button onClick={() => setShowLedger(true)} className='btn' data-testid='xp-ledger-btn'><ScrollText className='w-3 h-3 mr-1'/>XP Ledger</button>} alongside the other GM header buttons. Without this, the entire client-side feature is dead code — XPLedgerPanel.jsx and the wired-up state never activate.

Investigate why SessionView's 'OPENING THE TABLE' loading screen does not clear in the preview environment (5s useMinDelay was expected, but it persists 15s+). Possibly related to a slow/failing API call in the session-load chain (channels, dice log, chat, effects, initiative). Check /api/sessions/{sid}, /api/sessions/{sid}/chat, /api/sessions/{sid}/dice etc. for latency/errors.

After both fixes above, re-run frontend tests for: macro-bar render in dice-panel for BESM/D&D/Cypher campaigns, char-aware notation update on macro click, dice log entry creation on session-roll-btn, xp-breakdown-btn-{cid} → xp-breakdown-popover-{cid} in XPAwardPanel.
critical_code_review_comments: CampaignDetail.jsx — XP Ledger trigger button is missing (see action items). The setShowLedger state and conditional <XPLedgerPanel/> render are dead code without it.

SessionView.jsx line 136: useMinDelay(!session, 5000) imposes a deliberate 5-second floor on the loading screen — this is intentional UX but can mask actual data-fetch failures. Recommend adding a 30s timeout with error fallback so users see a real message instead of an indefinite ritual screen.

XPLedgerPanel.jsx — Solid implementation: filter chips with per-character data-testid (xp-ledger-filter-{cid}), entry rows (xp-ledger-entry-{eid}), totals block, escape via overlay click, GM-gated by parent. No issues from code review.

MacroBar.jsx — Clean component, system-aware logic for besm-4e/dnd-5e/cypher/anime-5e looks correct. Note the data-testid kebab-cases the label which yields 'macro-d20-1' for 'd20+1' and 'macro-d20--3' for 'd20-3' (double-dash because '-' is preserved while '+' becomes '-'). This matches the test plan exactly. The Macros() function takes an unused onPick parameter (line 21) — minor lint nit.

Backend xp.py /campaigns/{cid}/xp/ledger — clean implementation, includes 404 + 403 guards, returns all required fields, computes converted via abs(amount) for source='convert' entries (good). No _id leakage (uses {'_id':0} projection). No issues.
